subject: RELAPSE: ICS WhatsApp API Failed Again
body:
ALERT: The ICS WhatsApp API has failed again after showing signs of recovery.

Relapse Time: {relapse_time}
Current Status: {last_severity}
Error Details: {error_details}

SITUATION:
- The API briefly recovered but has failed again
- This indicates potential intermittent issues
- Service stability is NOT confirmed
- Users may experience inconsistent behavior

URGENT ACTIONS REQUIRED:
1. Escalate to ICS support immediately - report intermittent failures
2. Request detailed diagnostics from ICS operations team
3. Consider implementing fallback communication channels
4. Monitor closely for patterns (time-based, load-based, etc.)
5. Prepare stakeholder communication about ongoing issues

WARNING: DO NOT consider this issue resolved until consistent stability is confirmed over an extended period.

The monitoring system will continue tracking and will send updates as the situation evolves.
